purpose: Machine-readable manufacture/install/lookdev contract for benchmark-visible municipal park and street furniture. This is implementation evidence only; visual points require actual Unity renders.

referenceBasis.requirement: slide surface SUS304 thickness >=1.5 mm; SUS304 side sheet >=1.5 mm or painted steel side sheet >=2.3 mm
referenceBasis.useInModel: 2.0 mm SUS304 sliding skin and side sheets are used as a reference-bounded design assumption; exact manufacturer drawing for the fictional scene asset is not available.

referenceBasis.requirement: stainless slide example H2455 x W670 x L4185 mm; stainless sliding surface
referenceBasis.useInModel: confirms the scene slide's roughly four-metre run and stainless material class are physically plausible; it is not treated as the exact scene model.

assemblies.periodIntent: ordinary Japanese municipal/neighborhood park equipment plausible for the late 1980s through early 2000s
assemblies.manufacture: welded painted steel pipe support frame with bolted deck; separate formed SUS304 chute skin and raised side sheets
assemblies.installation: support frame is treated as fixed to the existing gameplay foundation/ground interface; generated visual shell adds no collider
assemblies.orientation: chute falls toward local +Z; surface centerline transitions from an approximately 26.6 degree initial slope to an approximately 1.7 degree runout
assemblies.exposure: full outdoor summer sun/rain; upward metal surfaces receive the strongest solar and water exposure

components.name: deck
components.evidence_status: structural visual proxy, not claimed manufacturer sheet thickness

components.name: stainless chute skin
components.geometry: continuous Hermite-swept shell; 96/48/24/12 longitudinal sections in LOD0/1/2/3

components.name: raised chute side sheets
components.geometry: swept with the same centerline so no separate blocky lip is visible

assemblies.interfaces: continuous chute skin begins just below deck elevation and terminates as a shallow runout; fasteners remain at deck interfaces; visual shell must not float or intersect hero geometry
assemblies.geometryVsMaterialDetail: sheet thickness, side height, rail diameters, slat/gap equivalents and fasteners are geometry; fine abrasion, paint orange-peel/chalking and contamination are material-scale detail
agingCauses: fine abrasion along stainless chute travel direction

assemblies.manufacture: five timber seat slats mechanically fastened to a steel bearer supported by two precast concrete legs
assemblies.installation: precast supports bear on the existing ground; generated render shell is collider-free and leaves gameplay collision to the legacy object
assemblies.orientation: slats run along local X; gaps are perpendicular to the long grain
assemblies.exposure: upward timber receives direct summer UV/rain; concrete feet receive splash and capillary moisture
assemblies.interfaces: lower 120 mm of concrete support has a darker, rougher ground-contact material because of capillary moisture/soil splash; no painted AO/contact shadow
assemblies.geometryVsMaterialDetail: five slats, real air gaps, bearer, supports and fasteners are geometry; grain/checks, UV bleaching and local polish are material-scale detail
agingCauses: sun bleaching on upward timber faces
capillary moisture and splash at concrete feet
forbidden: single giant wood cube at close range

assemblies.manufacture: precast/spun concrete pole with metal neck/cap and retained-ring globe-era diffuser; daytime lamp remains off
assemblies.installation: pole enters the existing ground/foundation interface; lower 200 mm is a causally darker moisture/splash zone
assemblies.exposure: full exterior weather; top cap and diffuser receive direct sun/rain while pole base receives splash/capillary moisture

components.name: aged diffuser
components.geometry: lathed five-point profile with 32/24/16/10 radial segments in LOD0/1/2/3

assemblies.periodAccuracy: globe/mercury-vapor-era visual language; explicitly reject a modern flat LED luminaire
assemblies.interfaces: diffuser narrows into retained collars rather than intersecting a generic sphere; ground moisture band is confined to lowest 200 mm
assemblies.geometryVsMaterialDetail: pole taper/segmentation, neck, caps and diffuser silhouette are geometry; diffuse aging and micro-scratches belong to material detail

assemblies.manufacture: two painted tubular posts supporting a framed weathered board/backing
assemblies.installation: two post feet meet the ground separately; no single central proxy support
assemblies.orientation: board face is approximately vertical; frame rails wrap all four edges
assemblies.exposure: top rail and upper board edge receive strongest sun/rain; post feet receive splash
assemblies.interfaces: post-foot darkening limited to lowest 160 mm; frame bolts stay at frame corners
assemblies.geometryVsMaterialDetail: posts, panel thickness, frame rails and corner fasteners are geometry; faded finish/wood-fibre or coating microstructure belongs to material detail
assemblies.periodAccuracy: no digital display, QR code, LED panel or other post-2000 visual cue in benchmark geometry

materials.microstructure: subtle orange-peel/chalking; no specular baked into albedo
materials.wetness: only localized after rain; dry benchmark default
materials.uvAging: slight chalking on sun-exposed upward/west-facing surfaces
materials.angularResponse: dielectric Fresnel; no metallic edge tint
materials.implementationStatus: scalar PBR implemented; dedicated micro-normal/roughness texture remains render-verification follow-up

materials.microstructure: fine directional abrasion along travel direction
materials.wetness: raises coherence and lowers apparent roughness only when rain state is active
materials.uvAging: none beyond contamination; stainless does not chalk like paint
materials.angularResponse: strong grazing reflection driven by environment and Fresnel, never painted highlight
materials.implementationStatus: scalar PBR implemented; directional abrasion texture/anisotropy must be judged from real grazing-light capture before visual credit
scalar PBR implemented; render verification pending

materials.microstructure: grain/checks run with slat length; geometry handles slat gaps
materials.wetness: darkens and reduces roughness only in rain state
materials.uvAging: up-facing slats may desaturate more than protected undersides
materials.angularResponse: dielectric Fresnel with broad finish response
materials.implementationStatus: scalar PBR implemented; directional wood microstructure texture remains pending real-render prioritization

materials.uvAging: minor tone change; no metallic or glossy aging
materials.implementationStatus: scalar PBR plus separate causally darker contact material implemented; micro-normal still requires capture-based tuning

lod.policy: LOD0 retains fasteners and highest curve/profile tessellation; LOD1 removes fasteners; LOD2/LOD3 reduce subcomponents/tessellation while preserving silhouette and material class
lod.criticalFail: visible pop or silhouette/material-class discontinuity in benchmark motion

criticalAutomaticFail: visible primitive-placeholder geometry in benchmark framing
